purpose: Focused Ghidra closure for the five pooled world-boss/end-stage families and the completion edges that can feed back into gameplay.

source.pipeline: research/tools/run_boss_static_closure.py; raw NE segments from ghidra_ne_segments.py --pad-to-memory; Ghidra -noanalysis; DumpBossDecomp.java, DumpExternalClosure.java, and DumpFocusedDisasm.java; no external x86 disassembler

pool_contract.callback_order: Boss records are inserted into the pooled phase scheduler; 01F7:0E96 dispatches phase 0/1/2 records and 01F7:0FA2 dispatches the selected nonzero-state list.
pool_contract.callback_return: Constructors and callbacks are far ES:DI object procedures. The scheduler does not consume a callback return flag. Nested helper flags remain address-named where the caller consumes CF/ZF directly.

shared_contracts.name: boss_pool_allocate_and_insert
shared_contracts.inputs_outputs: 0E06 allocates a 0x78-byte pooled record; constructors fill ES:DI and 1036 publishes it to the phase scheduler; exact allocator failure flags are not consumed by the boss callbacks.
shared_contracts.scheduler_position: constructor before the next phase pass
shared_contracts.object_effects: allocates/inserts boss, helper, child, and effect records
shared_contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through callback membership and object lifetime

shared_contracts.name: boss_scheduler_phase_passes
shared_contracts.inputs_outputs: global pooled-bank/list state; dispatches indirect far callbacks in stable phase/list order
shared_contracts.scheduler_position: 0E96 precedes 0FA2 in the main loop; player 3FF8 is in the later nonzero-state pass
shared_contracts.object_effects: callback execution, deferred release, and child publication
shared_contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through object state and ordering

shared_contracts.name: boss_damage_row_consumer
shared_contracts.inputs_outputs: ES:DI boss object; scans one DS:87DE row selected by object+0x2A, clears a matching row X, increments object+0x2C, and returns through an opaque callback tail; no scheduler flag is consumed
shared_contracts.scheduler_position: boss callback pass before the world-specific stage transition
shared_contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through stage gate, child callbacks, effect rows, and boss callback replacement; no direct player write

shared_contracts.name: shared_boss_effect_table
shared_contracts.inputs_outputs: 44FF resets the DS:87DE effect rows; 4519 allocates a row only when DS:88AE or DS:880C is nonzero and capacity permits; 45AB updates active rows; 470C removes them
probe_coordinates: row coordinates compared by world damage callbacks
shared_contracts.scheduler_position: producer/consumer edges interleave with pooled object callbacks
shared_contracts.object_effects: allocates, updates, and releases effect/projectile rows
shared_contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes when a row is consumed by a boss damage callback; presentation-only leaves stop at their closed contract

shared_contracts.name: boss_overlap_map_animation_edges
shared_contracts.inputs_outputs: shared object/player overlap, descriptor/map query, descriptor-cell decode, and animation-delay helpers; direct CF/ZF contracts are preserved in the listing
probe_coordinates: caller-supplied object/player bounds and map coordinates
shared_contracts.object_effects: animation cursor/timing and descriptor-dependent child/effect branches
shared_contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: only through caller branch decisions; sound-only leaves are outside the closure

unresolved.question: Raw protected-mode import cannot assign a stable target to several far calls; retain address-qualified unknowns until relocations/resource-selected targets or a parity mismatch identify them.
unresolved.simulation_feedback: unknown per-call; do not replace with guessed boss behavior

unresolved.question: Retail producer/timing for repeated DS:87DE rows and authored boss progression is not closed by the callback body.
unresolved.simulation_feedback: damage consumer and thresholds are closed; authored delivery remains runtime-boundary

unresolved.question: Completion producer and post-selector authored resource values remain open.
unresolved.simulation_feedback: handoff boundary is classified; no boss-specific C++ transition is inferred

static_stop: Stop at sound-only, renderer-only, and resource-selected leaves unless a held-out parity mismatch reaches them. Native boss implementation remains a later W1L1/W1L3 progression task because callback state machines are closed statically but retail damage timing and completion production are not.
